metadata.title: Opinion: Why it’s better to buy stocks at record highs than wait for the next crash - MarketWatch

content.text:
Outside the Box
Opinion: Why it’s better to buy stocks at record highs than wait for the next crash
Record highs are what bull markets do, so why try to avoid buying high? If you wait for a 20% drop, you could still pay more than what you’d pay now.
Stocks have been back to setting all-time highs, and that has some investors nervous.
That includes one of my longtime readers who recently told me he was reluctant to put new money into the market because “the stock market is at a record high.” He even pointed to Michael Burry of “The Big Short” fame, who has been warning about another crash.
